name: PT Mastersystem Infotama Tbk
summary: PT Mastersystem Infotama Tbk engages in the provision of information and communication technology infrastructure solutions and system integration services to enterprise banking, oil and gas, enterprise, and telecommunication markets in Indonesia. The company offers data center and cloud infrastructure, digital business management, enterprise collaboration, adaptive security architecture, data and AI, telco network solutions, as well as Cloud solutions. It also provides services, including Implementation Service, such as general, migration, and relocation services; maintenance; and managed services.
